page.overview:
Who is Ubrik Adelhard?

Ubrik Adelhard was a human male officer for the Galactic Empire who served as the governor of the Anoat sector with the rank of Moff during the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Endor, Adelhard reformed his forces into an Imperial remnant that quarantined the Anoat sector, and believing himself to be the next in line for the Imperial throne, ascended to the rank of Grand Moff, seeking to restore the Empire under his leadership. As a result, for the remainder of the Galactic Civil War, Adelhard refused to work with the remaining Imperial holdouts who were unknowingly carrying out the late Emperor's Contingency under the command of Counselor to the Empire Gallius Rax, while also pushing back against incursions from the newly formed New Republic. Yet still in need of forces to fulfill his plan to restore the Empire in his play for power, Adelhard allied himself with the forces of Grand General Kenner Loring, as well as those of the Acolytes of the Beyond and the Spice Runners of Kijimi, creating a coalition in doing so. Yet as Adelhard began pushing outwards from the Anoat sector against the New Republic, he was betrayed by the hired assassin from the Acolytes Reyna Oskure and was forced to escape to his presumed death and rot on the backwater planet Gallowyss with his most loyal troops. However, with many of his forces still loyal to him, Adelhard returned to his fleet, now a changed man, vowing to destroy those who had seen lesser of him and had seen him as nothing but a pawn; the New Republic and the Galactic Empire. During the Battle of Jakku Adelhard made his final bid for revenge, but was betrayed by the Spice Runners of Kijimi in his moment of victory, eventually coming being shot and killed by New Republic pilot Rynn Zenat after a brief duel with Luke Skywalker.

Born to a poor family on the lifeless Anoat sector mining planet Ripurni, Ubrik worked various mining jobs on the planet to survive until he witnessed the shooting of one of his coworkers at the hands of the Newly-formed Galactic Empire's TK stormtroopers. Amazed by the order, structure, and power that the troopers brought, Adelhard soon enlisted in the Imperial Army, himself becoming a TK trooper and later a Stormtrooper in the Imperial Stormtrooper Corps. Serving in the Storming of Abartolom and helping crush the Moraysi rebellion, Ubrik rose the ranks of the Imperial Military before eventually serving as an Imperial officer under Grand Admiral Thrawn's 7th Fleet by the time of the Battle of Atollon. Around 0 ABY, Adelhard, in command of an Imperial-class Star Destroyer, was dispatched back home to the Anoat sector to deal with a group of insurgents who had taken up a base in the sector's capital planet of Anoat. Having observed how those in the highest levels of command in the Empire held power an maintained order, Adelhard gave the order to gas the Ecumenopolis, turning the planet into a toxic waste dump, which was later framed as an industrial accident. Following the gassing, Darth Vader promoted Ubrik to the position of governor of the Anoat sector, telling the new Moff that the Empire had great plans for him, words which stuck with Adelhard long after.
